mapper.insert: insert into tickets ( ticket_no, title, description, type, status, priority, creator_user_id, assignee_user_id, approver_user_id, system_name, target_username, permission_level, resolution, version, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{ticketNo}, #{title}, #{description}, #{type}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{creatorUserId}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{approverUserId}, #{systemName}, #{targetUsername}, #{permissionLevel}, #{resolution}, #{version}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update tickets set extra_attempts = extra_attempts + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'APPROVED'
